## Featured Projects

### 1. CT Scan Visualization (Engineering Thesis for NCBJ)
* **Status:** Work in Progress
* **Role/Context:** Engineering Thesis developed for the National Centre for Nuclear Research (NCBJ / Narodowe Centrum Badań Jądrowych).
* **Tech Stack:** Python, Flutter, Dart, Full-stack, 3D Rendering, Radiographic Processing.
* **Description:** Specialized software solution designed to process, render, and visualize 3D industrial CT scans. Features an interactive interface enabling precise 3D radiographic data analysis.

### 2. Warehouse AI Vision (Signify Internal Project)
* **Status:** Work in Progress
* **Tech Stack:** Python, FastAPI, Computer Vision, Machine Learning.
* **Description:** AI-powered mobile solution for automated goods recognition. Leverages computer vision via FastAPI to detect and resolve stock discrepancies in real-time.

### 3. Forest Litter Moisture Predictive Model
* **Status:** Completed (Academic / Research)
* **Tech Stack:** ESP32, IoT, Python, Scikit-learn.
* **Description:** End-to-end IoT ecosystem for environmental monitoring and fire risk assessment. Uses microcontrollers (ESP32) and Scikit-learn predictive modeling to forecast forest litter moisture with high precision.

### 4. Commercial Web Platforms & Infrastructure Management
* **Status:** Completed / Ongoing Maintenance
* **Tech Stack:** WordPress, Web Development, Server Administration, Self-hosting.
* **Description:** End-to-end development, deployment, and ongoing administration of commercial B2B web platforms hosted on custom-built server infrastructure to optimize speed and reliability.
